title: Reparent Node Dialog lies about node being selected
body:
### Tested versions

repro in v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f]

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 22 May 2026 19:25:09 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Single-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (radeonsi, phoenix, ACO, DRM 3.64, 7.0.9-arch2-1) - AMD Ryzen 7 8745HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 28.18 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

- Opening the reparent node dialog from a fresh project load shows nothing highlighted (good).
- A node can be chosen from that list and used as the new parent, but the next time the dialog is opened, that node appears selected but is not really (pressing the reparent button does nothing)
- The list of nodes in the dialog must be "refreshed" (select a new node, then optionally go back to the original node that appeared selected)

This project was just re-opened before the recording. When I highlight the prominent part of the dialog box and shake the mouse, I tried pressing enter and nothing happened. But going down and then up selects the node for real

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/50ec0cb3-06cb-47c1-8dc3-534876474c27

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the reparent node dialog (assuming it has not been opened previously in this session)
2. Select a node and press reparent
3. Undo the reparent (Ctrl + z)
4. Open the dialog again, and the same node from the first time is highlighted, but pressing the reparent button just closes the dialog, even though a node was highlighted

N/A
